patch_description: The 4-distinct-parameter version (ry_a/ry_b/rz/zz_ring) scored lower (0.70) than the earlier 2-distinct-parameter design (0.74) despite similar accuracy, because parameter economy and convergence speed dominate the score. This edit reverts to the proven 2-parameter structure (single shared "ry_a" pre-rotation and single shared "theta" driving all RZ/ZZ/XX couplers), and applies the recommended duplication: the entire parametrized multi-shell block (ZZ ring, ZZ opposite-qubit, ZZ skip-2, XX ring) is duplicated once more under the same "theta" parameter, placed right before the backward CNOT ladder. This increases expressivity per parameter (evidence: prior duplication lifted score 0.71->0.73) while keeping n_distinct_params at 2, which should improve robustness/worst-group margin without any parameter-count penalty.
